General.Name: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited
General.Description: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited, a biopharmaceutical company, manufactures, markets, and trades in pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. It provides medicines for cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, and immunological conditions; oncology medicines under the TAGRISSO, Lynparza, ENHERTU, IMFINZI, and Zoladex brand names; rare diseases medicines under the Koselugo brand name; and respiratory medicines under the Symbicort and Fasenra brand names. The company also offers medicines for diabetes; and clinical trial services. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Bengaluru, India. AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited is a subsidiary of AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals AB.
